hero.title: A proposal tailored to each project
hero.description: Assessment costs depend on the area, available data, and required deliverables. We prepare a clear proposal after reviewing your needs.

subscription.title: Costs of separate tools
subscription.description: Using several tools and data sources can add coordination time and cost.

consulting.title: Coordinating separate workstreams
consulting.description: When data and reviews are handled separately, bringing findings together can be harder.

experts.title: Need for specialist review
experts.description: Site selection requires technical, environmental, and economic review, with a clear scope for each.

project.title: Clear scope for each project
project.description: Required data, work, and deliverables are defined in the project proposal before work begins.

speed.title: Data in one workflow
speed.description: Relevant information is reviewed together so site comparisons stay organized.

integrated.title: Outputs for your decision
integrated.description: Reports are shaped around the project’s key questions and agreed level of review.

cta.title: Request a project estimate
cta.description: Share your location, area, and project goals so we can discuss scope and proposed costs.
